::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 584,156 people lived in County Cork, up 7.6% on 2016. It had the second largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 68% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Cork was €1,542, the 6th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Cork

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Cork was €30,748, the third highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Cork was €394,500, the 5th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 6.4 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Cork, the 9th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 29% of households in County Cork rented their home, the 5th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 18% of people living in County Cork were born outside Ireland, the 15th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 45% of people aged 3 and over in County Cork said they could speak Irish, the third highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 36% of people at work in County Cork worked from home for at least part of the week, the 4th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 75% of people travelling to work in County Cork went by car, the 20th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Cork live more than 1.4 km by road from a GP, the 22nd furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Cork live more than 17.9 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 18th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 12.0% of County Cork in 2021, the 7th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
